protocol: Preserve all frozen learned heads, native probabilities, dead evidence and prior nested stop/restart costs. Add a tracking-only short-control log-odds residual and lower owner-switch costs. Select only on existing inner predictions, excluding the outer match. Contextual noise and alternate labels remain evaluation-only. All seven outer matches have already been opened, so this is an adaptive follow-up and not a new independent test.
selection: Score-first: maximize inner provider spellF1, macroF1 tie-break, equal match/regime weighting. Count-balanced: among candidates within 0.005 mean spellF1 of original inner reference, maximize fraction of moderate inner fixtures within 20% count error, then minimize mean absolute moderate count error, then maximize spellF1. Report both without choosing based on outer results.
control_note: Signed log-odds evidence requires an observed ball within 2.5 m of the favored team and at least 1 m closer than the opponent, ball speed at most 15 m/s, favored-player ball speed difference at most 8 m/s, and three consecutive supporting native frames. Backdate confirmed runs. Missing/invalid features add zero evidence; do not infer across gaps or halves. Add strength times logit(0.95) to learned ownership log odds. Do not alter Pdead. This is physical proximity evidence, not proof of controlled possession.
